newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgarian lev firms on rise in dollar supply.
newsitem.headline: Bulgarian lev firms on rise in dollar supply.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed at 515-522 per dollar in thin interbank volumes, up from 520-540 in the morning as foreigh currency supply slightly topped demand, dealers said.
"Dollar demand was relatively low today and was topped by supply, which helped the lev gain some ground," a dealer said.
Supply rose mainly because commercial banks sold dollars for levs to pay their minimum required reserves at the central bank (BNB) for November by the December 16 deadline, traders said.
The central bank was not seen buying foreign currency today, dealers said.
BNB officials were not immediately available for comment. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-876032
